timeline.title: A Decade of Impact
timeline.subtitle: From creation in 2013 to today, discover the key stages of our evolution

2013.title: Creation of the Platform
2013.desc: NGOs and associations involved in the basic sanitation sub-sector in Togo form a platform to bring this neglected issue out of the shadows.
context_list: Less than 1% of the State budget allocated to the sector
Disparate and unreliable data on sanitation
Improved sanitation facilities: 10% (2005) then 54% (2015 QUIBB) vs 12% (2015 JMP)
Hygiene rules poorly respected throughout the territory

2018.title: Integration of Drinking Water
2018.desc: For greater efficiency and in recognition of the intrinsic link between water and sanitation, members decided to integrate the issue of drinking water into the network's areas of intervention.

2020.title: Measurable Progress
2020.desc: With a population of 8,279,000 inhabitants, the national drinking water coverage rate increased from 53% (2019) to 60% (2020).
2020.challenges_desc: In semi-urban and rural areas, more than half of households still do not have sustainable access to drinking water, due to lack of funding for works and difficulties in sustainable management of existing infrastructure.

today.title: Today: A Strong Collective Voice
today.desc: CCEABT represents the collective voice of more than 40 civil society organizations in the Water, Hygiene, and Sanitation sector.

vision.title: Vision
vision.desc: Working to facilitate access for all to drinking water, hygiene, and sanitation, leading populations to permanently consume drinking water and use improved sanitary facilities for their needs.
